message.content:
**Winner:** Alex

**Why?**  
With only the two hole cards available (no community cards were provided), we compare the highest‑card hands:

| Player | Hole Cards | Highest Card |
|--------|------------|--------------|
| Alex   | A♠ K♠      | **Ace**      |
| Sam    | 2♦ 3♣      | 3            |
| Robert | Q♥ 10♥     | Queen        |
| Steve  | 4♠ 5♠      | 5            |

In Texas Hold’em, the hand with the highest card wins when no pairs or better are present. Alex’s Ace outranks all other high cards, so Alex is declared the winner.
